### Fix: app icons on webOS 5 (#2)
On rooted webOS 5 TVs every app showed the default icon. OpenLauncher loads other apps' icons through a link it creates in its own folder, but it only created that link when the TV refused to give it the app list without root, which is what webOS 6 and newer do. webOS 5 hands out the list freely, so the link was never made. It is now created on every rooted TV where OpenLauncher isn't trusted.

Also:
- Icons work whether webOS reports them as a file name, a full path or a web address.
- The fallback icon for non-rooted TVs points to the right file.

Not tried on a webOS 5 TV yet. If icons still don't show, please comment on #2.

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.openlauncher_2.0.2_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel, Dev Manager, Discoverium or `ares-install`. You can also use **Update** on OpenLauncher's About page.
